page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre with page number at top left. Catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: non ageretur simpliciter de excommunicatione, sed etiam de ingentis exercitus expulsione, deinde excommunicare infert fugare & expellere, quae verba excommunicationis effectum paulo clarius exprimuntDeniqve omnes testimonii periodi de excommunicatione & anathemate diserte loquuntur.Nihil ideo necessarium est, per מנרים[?] eam exprimere, sed excommunicationis effectus fugam & expulsionem.

2. Ais,notari debuisse von vobis & nobis, &c. desumptum esse ex Esdrae. 4.v,8. lector curiosus potest hoc ex concordan-tiis[?] eruere, non semper vacat interpreti-bus haec in qvirere, nec semper ad manum concordantiae, aut ista suggerit memoria. Tamrigidam ἀχεθείαν[?] nec curavi, nec curare velim, cum praefertim ad sensus in-terpretationem nihil faciat.

3. Inter loco peccasse fateor, sed nulla sensus, licet aliqua perspicuitatis, jactu-ra. Illud enim וישלח ספרי[?] non autoris, sed scripturae verba sunt, quae inter-pretatur. Deinde illud והעת קה[?] scribendum erat והעתיקו[?] ut est in textu A-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Hebrew words מנרים, וישלח ספרי, והעת קה and והעתיקו are marked [?]; the Greek ἀχεθείαν is uncertain in its middle letters and is marked [?]. Concordan-tiis: the letter after the hyphen is faint and marked [?]. Printing errors left as printed: missing spaces in "exprimuntDeniqve" and "loquuntur.Nihil"; "expulsionem." is followed directly by the line end; "Ais,notari" has no space after the comma. The page number is printed as a long-s-like "s10", read as 510. Right margin dark strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
